entry.title: Ferry services to the Family Islands suspended as swell builds
entry.summary: Mailboat and ferry operators suspended services to Exuma and Long Island on Monday as sea conditions deteriorated, the Port Department said.

entry.title: Suspect caught hiding in business as police probe vehicle thefts
entry.summary: Police arrested a man in Nassau after a string of vehicle thefts.

entry.title: Portion of East Street closed to traffic for three weeks
entry.summary: The Ministry of Works said a section of East Street will be closed to traffic from Monday while crews replace a culvert. Traffic will be diverted through Soldier Road.
